notes: Change detection uses event-driven helpers that compare $time of each output change with the time of its legal events (own clock edge, reset fall, i_rst_n_sw change for o_full/o_full_thr, and the i_clk_wr edge for o_empty/o_empty_thr rising while o_sw_rst_busy was 0 before the edge). Violation counters are checked with $stable on the matching clock. Hits are counted on the write clock only, because a second always_ff would drive the same counter. The rise of o_sw_rst_busy is not checked directly, to avoid a race with o_empty in the same time step. This was not compiled in Verilator.
